# COVERAGE

Distribution of sequencing coverage across target and background regions.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Synthetic sequencing summary for DEMO-001"
knitr::kable(data.frame(Metric=c("Reads", "Yield", "Read N50", "Median target depth", "Targets above 30×", "Mapping rate"), Value=c("4,820,000", "28.4 Gb", "8,420 bp", "184×", "97.2%", "98.1%")))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Invented target and background coverage distributions"
set.seed(41)
boxplot(list(Targets=rlnorm(250,log(184),0.4), Background=rlnorm(250,log(24),0.45)), col=c("#3569a8", "#a8b8c8"), ylab="Coverage (×)", outline=FALSE)
```

# CNV

Copy-number profile across the genome.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Synthetic copy-number profile; no patient data"
x <- seq_len(220)
y <- rep(2,220); y[45:70] <- 3; y[145:162] <- 1
y <- y + rnorm(220,0,0.08)
plot(x,y,pch=16,cex=0.55,col=ifelse(y>2.5,"#ba4b42",ifelse(y<1.5,"#3569a8","#81868c")),xlab="Genome bins (illustrative)",ylab="Copy number",ylim=c(0,4))
abline(h=2,lty=2,col="gray60")
```
